candidates.change_summary: Replace positionExpirations assignment condition to always use positionId instead of the ternary, breaking long-position expiration keying.
Delete the positionExpirations state update entirely so fillOrder never writes position expiration.
Change expiration timestamp from block.timestamp + order.duration to block.timestamp - order.duration so the stored expiration is in the past.

Replace the mutated key's fee read with a read from a different key: read unclaimedFees[asset] swapped with unclaimedFees[address(0)] so the differing key can be asset while the caller may pass any recipient.
Report the fees amount as zero to the downstream transfer while still zeroing the stored balance.
Remove the zeroing of unclaimedFees[asset], leaving accumulated fees in place after withdrawal.
Remove the ERC20 transfer so the accumulated fee balance is cleared but the tokens are never sent.
Move the unclaimedFees[asset] = 0 state update from before the external ERC20 transfer to after it, changing reentrancy-visible ordering.
Delete the line that resets unclaimedFees[asset] to zero, so withdrawn fees remain claimable.
Delete the ERC20(asset).transfer(recipient, fees) external call, so the function completes without transferring any tokens.
Replace the unclaimedFees[asset] lookup with reading the recipient's balance as fees, changing the amount transferred.
Delete the owner check in the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call owner-restricted functions.
Replace the owner equality check with a trivially true condition, allowing anyone to pass the onlyOwner guard.
